title: Separate normal queue from CSV rerun state
summary: Separate normal pipeline queue state from dedicated local and Network CSV rerun state, add deterministic current-rerun selection, and make blank Run Once scope use only fresh matching normal-queue evidence.
reason: The Main Queue mixed dedicated rerun recovery rows with normal pipeline work, stale snapshot age could outrank concrete review evidence, and the frontend retained a synthesized rerun continuation fallback instead of using backend-declared actions.
behavior_before: GET /api/queue could fall back to or append dedicated CSV rerun rows; the rerun table rendered aggregate history as current work; stale queue evidence could become the first review state; blank Run Once had no authoritative normal-queue zero-work check; continuation UI could synthesize a manifest request.
behavior_after: GET /api/queue returns normal rows only with compatibility metadata. GET /api/rerun/results exposes separate aggregate history and backend-selected current_local/current_network summaries, where active requires exact live-process correlation. Blank Run Once blocks only on a fresh matching zero-runnable snapshot, stale/missing/mismatched/scanning evidence stays advisory, and WebView recovery controls use backend-authored available_actions only.
tests_added: Blank Run Once normal_queue_scope covers fresh zero, fresh runnable, stale, missing/mismatched, and scanning snapshots without changing continuous/validate/single-file scope.
Current rerun selection prefers exact live activity, then recovery actions, then nonterminal review, and ignores terminal-only history.
Normal queue excludes local and Network CSV rerun manifests, including empty-normal-queue fallback cases.
WebView static contracts pin blocker normalization, stale advisory wording, current-versus-history rendering, empty CSV picker text, and backend-only rerun actions.
